cfp.methodology: Neutral-site championship games between each conference's two leading conference-win teams; ties resolved by model rating. Five highest-ranked champions plus seven at-large. Conference-specific qualification and tiebreak rules and CFP committee decisions not modeled.

projected_bracket.methodology: Projected top-two conference finishers play a neutral-site title game, with the higher-rated finalist favored. Five highest-ranked champions and seven at-large; conference-specific rules and committee selections not modeled.
